name: UnSub (PentAGI-based orchestration, Asian telecom/integrators) — GTIG
description: GTIG describes a customized PentAGI (multi-agent Kali sandbox with Metasploit, nmap, SQLmap) orchestration campaign, used between at least late August and early October 2026, systematically scanning system integrators and major telecommunications firms in Asia; most activity stayed at WHOIS asset mapping or vulnerability scanning but some operations progressed to active intrusion and persistence. A separate PentAGI chain with proxy services targeted the aerospace sector. *Analyst note: no nexus, motivation or victim counts stated. Vendor source.* GTIG
